card.name: Linking words before a purpose or explanation
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, for, since, that, it, the right after a clause, where a purpose or explanation clause is about to begin. Mostly in technical or explanatory text.

modes.label: Purpose link
modes.description: The word 'to', 'for' or 'that' introduces the purpose of what was just described.
modes.example: If they are colored, the number clues will also be colored in order<< to>> indicate the color of the squares.

modes.label: Reason link
modes.description: A word like 'since' or 'the' opens the reason clause in a technical explanation.
modes.example: adding multiple delta-v values provides a pessimistic result,<< since>> the rocket can thrust while at an angle

modes.label: Subject of a how-it-works clause
modes.description: A noun or pronoun starts a clause that explains how something works or is stored.
modes.example: A type of semiconductor memory in which the<< information>> is stored in capacitors on a MOS

card.writes: The promoted tokens are scattered and the suppressed ones concern even spreading, so there is no clear output effect beyond a weak push away from 'evenly' and 'distributes'.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words that lead into a 'so that' or 'because' style explanation in technical text.
